name: public_holiday_lookup
description: Retrieves public holiday dates for an ISO country code and calendar year using the free Nager.Date API.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as US or CA.

year.description: Calendar year to query. Defaults to the current year.

include_subdivisions.description: Include ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes when the holiday applies only to part of a country.
